# Qué es $\varepsilon$-greedy

pandoc writes the heading's MathML into the nav as well, and declares it on
the chapter only: epubcheck refused the package. The date in Spanish was
written as an empty dc:date, which it refused too. Both build now; the
formula warns, since Adobe's engine shows MathML as text.
